environment.description: Equivalent local developer reference environment; in-process ASGI driver over the real FastAPI app with a local Docker PostgreSQL connection pool

protocol.clock_boundary: reconnect request receipt to delivery of the last outstanding persisted event
protocol.clock_boundary_note: Delivery is observed at the ASGI send boundary — the last point inside the application process before the socket — so the figure excludes network transit only. Starlette's TestClient buffers a streaming body to completion before returning, so it can observe neither per-frame delivery nor a stream that stays open, and was deliberately not used.
protocol.replay_backlog_rationale: the timeline read cap in api/routers/conversations.py — the largest number of activities the product renders at once
protocol.last_event_id: absent; the stalest possible cursor, replaying the entire backlog from sequence 0

version_bindings.dataset: 2 governed fixtures (sample_tiny_input:v1, sample_tiny_input_more_tm:v1); contract sha256 digests recorded alongside
version_bindings.tool: in-process ASGI driver over the real FastAPI app (both http middleware layers active), PostgreSQL 18 in Docker
version_bindings.policy: NFR35/AD-26: reconnect replay to current state completes within 5000 ms; a miss blocks implementation acceptance of Story 2.4
